title: Product Owner flashcards: for the Professional Scrum Product Owner I (PSPO I) assessment

checks.what: An independent audit read all 307 cards: the 255 that quote the Scrum, Evidence-Based Management and Nexus Guides against their quotes, which the card checker found word for word, and the 52 written in our own words against the saved scrum.org pages
checks.result: No wrong answers; 2 unsupported claims, 1 ambiguous card, 2 unclear ones and 7 minor issues were fixed.
